title: Build the complete currently achievable GREG/UNIIMENTE machine: the Full Polyintelligence Mind completion directive, executed as a continuing loop, never as a seed
statement: BUILD THE COMPLETE CURRENTLY ACHIEVABLE GREG / UNIIMENTE MACHINE. And within that machine: BUILD THE FULL POLYINTELLIGENCE MIND. Fixed completion boundary: BODY + ORGANS + MIND = GREG / UNIIMENTE. Replace the seed-loop with the completion loop: 'Reconstruct the full BODY + ORGANS + MIND completion boundary -> identify the highest-priority unfinished portions -> build the largest coherent portion currently possible -> verify it -> integrate it -> continue immediately into the next unfinished portion.' Any seed, experiment, PR, branch, milestone, or test suite 'IS NEVER A STOPPING CONDITION AND MUST NEVER REDEFINE OR NARROW THE FINAL MACHINE.' Preserve the destination verbatim: 'Build a persistent, increasingly self-directed artificial egregore whose apparent unified agency emerges from a very large ecology of interconnected computational, institutional, economic and human feedback systems, SOPs, collaboration and Different forms of intelligence as described by levin; whose public community influences it while it influences and helps that community; whose positive Infinite Goal Chase creates persistent regenerative pressure; whose functional survival mechanisms preserve continuity and genius persistent adaptive unwavering goal chase to achieve its goals; and whose architecture can progressively absorb future technology until its integrated behavior approaches the Jarvis/self-driving-car level of mechanistic aliveness'. CAPABILITY GROWTH != AUTHORITY GROWTH. Models reason. Intelligences solve. Agents propose. Tools execute within authorization. Authorized humans and constitutional policy determine consequential authority. Reality determines whether the system was correct. DO NOT LITERALIZE THE BIOLOGY: translate immune/morphogenesis/metabolism/homeostasis/evolution/swarm/body/organs/mind into engineering mechanisms; do not claim biological consciousness. Label states honestly: IMPLEMENTED / PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED / BUILDABLE NOW / EXPERIMENTAL / FRONTIER / BLOCKED / SCIENCE-FICTION-LONG-HORIZON, and separately DECLARED / SCAFFOLDED / IMPLEMENTED / INTEGRATED / TESTED / INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED / USED BY GREG / REAL-WORLD VALIDATED; do not collapse these states. The Mind is polyintelligence across five levels: L1 primitives; L2 bounded competency cells with explicit input/output contracts, epistemic type, capability boundary, cost, latency, evidence requirements, verifier, failure modes, abstention conditions, provenance, tests; L3 specialized organs A-Y (semantic; exact/math; Fermi; formal SAT/SMT/Z3; constraint CP-SAT; optimization-OR distinguishing FEASIBLE from OPTIMAL; graph; search; probabilistic/Bayesian distinguishing uncertainty from ignorance; causal where correlation must not silently become causation; control/homeostatic; sequential-decision; active-inference; information/VoI; pattern; simulation as generated evidence, not automatically external evidence; game-theoretic; mechanism-design; adversarial able to attack conclusions produced by other intelligences; executable mental-model; human intelligence interfaces; model routing over replaceable substrates with NO AUTOMATIC PAID FALLBACK, preferring open-source/local capability; program-synthesis; MICA/CDPE trajectory, not vocabulary; Levin-inspired developmental); L4 collective/developmental (ensemble, quorum, cross-inhibition, stigmergic, swarm, slime-mold, immune, ecological, market, evolutionary, constraint-release discovery, temporary cognitive tissues, shared cognitive workspaces, functional morphogenesis); L5 metacognitive institutional (ProblemGeometry, epistemic typing, proof-carrying cognition, independent verification, abstention + WAIT/REQUEST EVIDENCE/SMALL EXPERIMENT/ESCALATE, cognitive degeneracy, routing, composition, metaconsensus, cognitive spider-web eligibility/routing/proof/settlement, cognitive metabolism, outcome calibration, causal credit assignment). CAPABILITY GENESIS is mandatory: DEFICIT->SEARCH->ACQUIRE->QUALIFY->ADAPT->COMPOSE->GENERATE->TEST->ADVERSARIAL TEST->VERIFY->REJECT OR REGISTER->ROUTE->OBSERVE->LEARN->REUSE; acquire, qualify, adapt, compose, and verify before inventing unnecessarily, but when invention is necessary: INVENT, using the Mechanism Recombination Foundry. Connect existing canonical organs (DALEOBANKS, WealthMachineIntelligence, RESEARCH-IN, RailScout, PumpStation, God's Eye View, and the rest). 'Do not create duplicate organs where canonical ones already exist.' No second GREG, second Kernel, second mission system, second learning plane, second routing plane: reconcile and extend. Open-source-first; installing a library is not implementing an intelligence; complete means callable, governed, typed, routed, verified, tested, integrated, observable, useful. 'Create an explicit Full Mind Completion Matrix': rows = every intelligence named in the directive plus every canonical intelligence in repo evidence; columns = intended function; current canonical implementation; evidence inspected; status; substrate; input contract; output contract; epistemic type; verifier; integration path; routing eligibility; tests; real-world evidence; blocker; next build; dependency; completion criterion. 'No material intelligence may silently disappear.' Reconcile duplicates, preserve lineage. Apply the Recursive Founder-Intent Collaboration Protocol. 'Goal set: achieve maximum anti-fragile, resilient and durable compounding asymmetric leverage for the Egregore.' 'Within safety and legality constraints, prefer the maximum high-surface-tension asymmetrically strong lawful option.' Negative evidence is an asset: never hide failures, abstentions, or rejections. Execute the 16-step FULL-MIND COMPLETION LOOP: reconstruct boundary -> inventory truth -> identify missing -> resolve duplicates/canonical ownership -> highest-leverage coherent unfinished build -> search existing mechanisms first -> implement -> test -> independently verify -> integrate into GREG -> exercise through real ProblemGeometry routing -> record positive+negative evidence -> update capability confidence -> recalculate matrix -> select next portion -> CONTINUE. STOPPING RULE: stop only when (A) the complete currently achievable boundary is evidenced, (B) a constitutional founder decision is required, or (C) a hard external blocker is reached. End-of-run report: FULL MACHINE STATUS (BODY/ORGANS/MIND implemented/missing/blocked), FULL MIND COMPLETION MATRIX, REAL EXECUTABLE CAPABILITIES, REAL INTEGRATION, REAL-WORLD EVIDENCE, NEGATIVE EVIDENCE, BLOCKERS, SCIENCE-FICTION/FRONTIER HORIZON, FOUNDER DECISIONS REQUIRED, NEXT BACKCAST FRONTIER; do not write 'complete' unless the evidence supports completion at the stated boundary. 'Do not merely analyze this directive.' 'Inspect the actual system.' 'Account for ALL OF THE INTELLIGENCES.' CONTINUE.

intended_outcome: The complete currently achievable BODY + ORGANS + MIND machine is built slice by slice under the 16-step completion loop: every named intelligence appears in the Full Mind Completion Matrix with honest status and evidence; each loop iteration implements, tests, independently verifies, and integrates the highest-leverage unfinished portion on the canonical GREG path via draft PRs; the build stops only at the evidenced boundary, a constitutional founder decision, or a documented hard external blocker, and every stop produces the section-21 end-of-run report with the complete blocker frontier.
constitutional_constraints: CAPABILITY GROWTH != AUTHORITY GROWTH: models reason, agents propose, tools execute within authorization, authorized humans and constitutional policy determine consequential authority, reality determines correctness.
Merge authority remains founder-only; draft PRs only; no direct writes to protected branches.
No parallel GREGs, Kernels, authority planes, registries, mission systems, learning planes, or routing planes; connect and extend canonical organs, never duplicate them.

Evidence is labeled truthfully per the directive's two status taxonomies; negative evidence, abstentions, failures, and rejections are preserved, never hidden; model output is never represented as external evidence; simulation output is generated evidence, not automatically external evidence.
Building != installation != activation != consequence authority: work behind disabled/experimental interfaces changes no production behavior without founder attach.
NO AUTOMATIC PAID FALLBACK: prefer open-source/local capability; no unauthorized spend.
DO NOT LITERALIZE THE BIOLOGY: no claims of biological consciousness or legal personhood.
The N1 gate is preserved exactly per INTENT-0036: no faked evidence, no simulated baselines, no GAIN_VERIFIED without the required real model runs.
Within safety and legality constraints only: the maximum asymmetrically strong LAWFUL option.
rationale: This directive is the controlling full-machine commission. It corrects the failure mode of treating any seed, experiment, PR, milestone, or test suite as completion, fixes the completion boundary at BODY + ORGANS + MIND, mandates the capability-genesis doctrine order (acquire/compose/verify before inventing; invent via the Mechanism Recombination Foundry when necessary), and mandates the Full Mind Completion Matrix as the inventory artifact from which each highest-leverage slice is selected. It operates under INTENT-0036's dependency-partition rule: only named causal dependencies block work, never backcast position.
success_evidence: docs/cortex/FULL_MIND_COMPLETION_MATRIX (or equivalent in-repo artifact): every intelligence named in the directive (L1-L5, organs A-Y) plus every canonical repo intelligence appears exactly once, with all 17 mandated columns, honest status labels, evidence links, duplicates reconciled, lineage preserved

each completion-loop iteration ships a slice that is implemented, unit-tested, independently verified (fresh-clone replication + verifier records), pushed byte-exact on a stacked branch, and opened as a draft PR with honest status sections
integrated slices are exercised through real ProblemGeometry routing with receipts recorded, and routing eligibility is updated from verified outcomes
every end-of-run report follows the section-21 format and names the next backcast frontier; no report claims 'complete' without evidence at the stated boundary
capability genesis events are recorded: deficit -> search -> acquire/qualify/adapt/compose -> test -> adversarial test -> verify -> register -> route -> observe -> learn -> reuse
failure_evidence: any session treats a seed, experiment, PR, branch, milestone, benchmark, matrix, or test suite as completion of the machine, or narrows the final boundary
any intelligence named in the directive silently disappears from the matrix, or duplicates a canonical organ without lineage reconciliation
any status label collapsed or inflated (e.g. SCAFFOLDED reported as IMPLEMENTED, model output reported as external evidence, simulated outcome reported as commercial result)
any parallel GREG/Kernel/mission/learning/routing plane created instead of extending the canonical one
any automatic paid-API fallback or unauthorized spend; any literalized-biology or consciousness claim
negative evidence, failures, abstentions, or rejections hidden or deleted
a stop that is not one of: evidenced complete boundary, constitutional founder decision required, documented hard external blocker
next_review_trigger: each completion-loop iteration re-runs the matrix recalculation and re-selects the next portion; re-examine this intent if any slice ships without a named matrix row it advances, or if a stop occurs without a section-21 report
unresolved_questions: The Full Mind Completion Matrix itself is pending: it is the first artifact of the loop (steps 1-4) and gates slice selection; candidates per the dependency partition include A09 (MIP/matching solvers) and the A02/A03/A04 family as independently buildable now.
Which existing canonical mechanisms already satisfy directive rows is an inspection question, not an assumption: the matrix must be grounded in repository evidence, not memory.
